ValidationRule.description: The source must belong to the same member and a refund must reverse the original redemption.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The source must belong to the same member and a refund must reverse the original redemption.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR(AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Transaction__c)), Member__c <> Transaction__r.Member__c), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Voucher__c)), Member__c <> Voucher__r.Member__c), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Reverses_Entry__c)), OR(Member__c <> Reverses_Entry__r.Member__c, NOT(ISPICKVAL(Reverses_Entry__r.Entry_Type__c, "Redemption")), Voucher__c <> Reverses_Entry__r.Voucher__c, Points__c <> -Reverses_Entry__r.Points__c)))
